name: n4_read_schedule
description: One schedule decoded into plain JSON (one load; read-only), for every kind n4_list_schedule_kinds lists. kind and type; for boolean, numeric, enum and string schedules: out, next_time, next_value, default_output, in and facets (each value is {value, status}: value true/false, a number, an enum ordinal or a string, null when the status is null; status ok, null or the station's encoding), out_source (what drives out: Input, Special Event: <name>, Week: <day> or Default Output), effective (always, or the date range rule of the effective period), weekly (monday to sunday, each a list of {start, end, value} sorted by start, times HH:MM with end 24:00 for a range that runs to midnight; a range the station holds without a value is listed with value null and ignored true, since the station skips it) and special_events in priority order (name, kind, rule, priority 1 = highest, ranges). Rules by kind: date {year, month, day, weekday}, each "*" when it matches any; date_range {start, end} (two date rules); week_and_day {month, week, weekday}; custom {year, months, days, weeks, weekdays} (lists, empty = any); reference {calendar: the calendar ORD}. Months are jan..dec, odd, even; weekdays sunday..saturday; weeks week1..week5, last7days, calendarWeek1..calendarWeek6, before_last7/14/21. calendar: out, next_time, next_value and dates (name, kind, rule). trigger: enabled, times (HH:MM), dates, last_trigger and next_trigger. Every slot the station leaves out because it holds its default is filled from the station's type registry; a slot neither sent nor described is an error, never a guess. last_modified is the station's time of the last change.

ord.description: The schedule component's ORD, e.g. station:|slot:/Schedules/Lobby
